describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, low to the ground on four short limbs with a long, broad, flattened tail extending to the left. Its body is stout and elongated with a pale, wrinkled, pinkish-gray underside and belly, while the entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck over the back and tail is covered in large overlapping brownish-gray scales. The head at the right end is broad, flat and rounded at the snout with small dark eyes on the sides, small nostrils at the tip, and a wide slightly upturned mouth, bearing six feathery reddish-pink external gills around the neck. The overall appearance is a chimera with a smooth-skinned amphibian front and a heavily armored scaly back and tail.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile with pale pinkish-gray wrinkled skin on the head, underside, and limbs and a long tapering tail. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, small dark eyes, and a wide mouth. Behind the head on both sides are multiple long pinkish stalks bearing dense reddish feathery filaments. The torso is low-slung with four short thick limbs ending in splayed clawed toes. The entire dorsal surface from behind the head to the tip of the tail is covered in neat overlapping rows of rounded brown glossy scales, while the throat, belly, and underside of the tail are pale and transversely wrinkled.
